text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san. To think that I would be able 
to compete with you like this in this 
winter Grand Prix as well!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, what joy! What bliss!! I can't help 
but sing, Lu~la-la~~~~♪"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Seriously... you're noisy 365 days a year, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hawa... Wawa, I'm, well, H-Happy too...!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
“B-But... that just means I have to p-pump 
myself up and try even harder...!!”

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I-I just don't want to lose... is all!! 
Not to Opera O-san, and not to Ayabe-san 
either...!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—I look forward to working with you! I'm 
Narita Top Road!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan B
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*, *hic*...! Congratulations on 
entering the Arima Kinen! I truly, totally 
believe you're gonna wiiiin--!!
